body:
> This is because you're using multiple hooks in a single component. That's an edge case that will be covered by [#6660](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6660) and the `skipSuspense` option so that a second widget will be discoverable in the server.
>
> solutions are thus:
>
> 1. wait until the option is released
> 2. patch InstantSearch yourself to include the code of [feat(nextjs): add a `skipSuspense` arg to allow hook composition #6660](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6660)
> 3. use only one hook per component
>
> The underlying reason for this happening is that we suspend at the first hook already, meaning the second widget in the same component won't be discovered.

Cool will give it a try. When you say "two hooks in the same component" do you mean the search component which has 2 <CustomRefinementList> ? so I should add skipSuspense all but the last one (based on the warn in the pr)
